description.summary: This ninjutsu suppresses any sound made by the ninja and allies within 10 feet
description.value: This ninjutsu suppresses any sound made by the ninja and allies within 10 feet. The ninja cannot be heard from outside sources during this ninjutsu’s effect. This includes attacking, moving, and speaking. This doesn’t hinder the ninja or allies from casting ninjutsus that require verbal components. The ninja and allies that are affected by the same cast of this ninjutsu can hear each other normally. This lasts for the duration of the ninjutsu.
